test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Two trains of length 220 m and 280 m are running towards each other on parallel lines at 42 km/h and 30 km/h, respectively. In how much time will they be clear of each other from the moment they meet?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of train 1 (L₁) = 220 m

Length of train 2 (L₂) = 280 m

Speed of train 1 (S₁) = 42 km/h

Speed of train 2 (S₂) = 30 km/h

**Formula used:**

Relative speed when moving towards each other = S₁ + S₂

Time to pass each other = Total length / Relative speed

**Calculations:**

Relative speed = 42 km/h + 30 km/h

⇒ Relative speed = 72 km/h

⇒ Relative speed in m/s = 72 × (5 / 18) = 20 m/s

Total length = 220 m + 280 m = 500 m

Time = Total length / Relative speed

⇒ Time = 500 m / 20 m/s = 25 s

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
